The Americans and Britons argue over whether to trust him, but gradually surrender navigation and survival decisions to the calm, capable sailor. They discover too late that Willi has hidden water and supplies, deceived them about their course and is steering them toward a German vessel; after the injured Gus dies and Willi's betrayal becomes undeniable, the survivors turn on and kill him. Forced to row and think for themselves, they are finally spotted during a naval battle and expect rescue. When another young German sailor climbs aboard with a gun, they disarm rather than kill him, ending with the unresolved question of what war requires people to become.

episodes.title: Cluny Brown (1950-11-23)
episodes.episodeDescription: Free-spirited Cluny Brown has an inconvenient passion for plumbing that her uncle considers improper for a young woman, and she is sent into domestic service at an English country estate to learn her place. There she meets refugee professor Adam Belinski, another outsider who recognizes how badly Cluny fits the rigid social rules around her. Cluny tries to become respectable by accepting the attentions of conventional pharmacist Mr. Wilson, but her impulse to repair the plumbing during his mother's formal party proves that she cannot turn herself into the woman he expects. Wilson recoils, while Belinski offers Cluny a life where her impulses are part of who she is rather than a disgrace. She leaves with him, becoming Mrs. Belinski and trading a prescribed place in society for an uncertain but shared future.

episodes.title: Mrs Mike (1950-11-30)
episodes.episodeDescription: Boston-raised Kathy O'Fallon marries Mountie Sergeant Mike Flanagan and follows him into the isolated Canadian North, where she must learn to live with brutal cold, cultural differences, scarce supplies and Mike's responsibility for everyone in his enormous district. The hardships gradually become part of their shared life until an epidemic sweeps the settlement. Despite Mike's efforts and the eventual arrival of serum, their baby dies, and Kathy, overwhelmed by grief, decides she cannot survive the North and leaves. Mike transfers back to his old post believing he has lost her. Kathy ultimately turns back after seeing another frontier family recover from the loss of a child, telling Mike that they cannot let the North defeat them and that, together, they will keep fighting it.

episodes.title: My Favorite Wife (1950-12-07)
episodes.episodeDescription: After seven years missing at sea, Ellen Arden returns home on the very day her husband Nick has finally had her declared legally dead and married Bianca. Ellen tries to reclaim her place without immediately shattering the children or the new marriage, while Nick desperately searches for a legal and emotional way out of the absurd situation. Matters get worse when Nick learns Ellen spent the shipwreck years on an island with another man, provoking a new round of jealousy and concealment. The complications finally collapse under the truth, Bianca is released from the mistaken marriage, and Nick and Ellen reunite as husband and wife.

episodes.title: The Lady Gambles (1950-12-14)
episodes.episodeDescription: Newspaper wife Joan Booth accompanies her husband David to Las Vegas and treats casino gambling as harmless vacation excitement. A small win and the attention of casino manager Corrigan awaken a compulsion she cannot control; soon she is borrowing money, chasing losses, lying to David, and choosing the tables over her marriage. Her addiction carries her from respectable casinos to private games and eventually to the bottom, where she is found beaten and nearly destroyed after a year away from her husband. David refuses to abandon her and works with doctors to uncover the fear, resentment, and family wounds feeding the obsession. A final emotional confrontation with her sister Ruth forces Joan to face the truth instead of escaping into gambling. When David reaches for her, Joan finally reaches back, accepts his help, and leaves with him determined to begin again.

episodes.title: Miracle on 34th Street (1950-12-21)
episodes.episodeDescription: When the Santa hired for Macyâ€™s Thanksgiving parade is found drinking, a kindly old man named Kris Kringle takes his place and soon becomes the department storeâ€™s most convincing Santa. Kris insists that he truly is Santa Claus, winning the trust of practical-minded little Susan while challenging the skepticism of her mother Doris. Lawyer Fred Gailey believes in Kris and also hopes to break through Dorisâ€™s guarded outlook. After store psychologist Sawyer helps have Kris committed to Bellevue, Kris deliberately fails his examination in despair, but Fred persuades him not to give up and takes his case to court. The judge demands authoritative proof of Krisâ€™s identity, and the case turns when the Post Office delivers nine truckloads of letters addressed simply to Santa Claus, effectively recognizing Kris as their proper recipient. The case is dismissed. Susan and Doris both affirm their belief, while Kris quietly points Fred toward a Cape Cod cottage that could give Fred, Doris and Susan the family home Susan has wished for.

episodes.title: Alias Nick Beal (1950-12-28)
episodes.episodeDescription: Idealistic district attorney Joseph Foster is desperate to convict racketeer Hanson when mysterious Nick Beal offers him the evidence he needs. Each favor draws Foster deeper into compromise: forged books win the case, political influence carries him toward the governor's office, and Beal plants glamorous Donna Allen beside him while gradually isolating him from his wife and conscience. Foster finally realizes Beal's bargains amount to a claim on his soul. After resigning the governorship rather than serve the corrupt interests that elected him, Foster is still bound by a written contract requiring him to follow Beal. Reverend Garfield places the agreement inside a Bible, which Beal cannot take, breaking his hold. Foster is saved, while Beal withdraws to wait for other people willing to make the same bargain.

episodes.title: Prince of Foxes (1951-01-04)
episodes.episodeDescription: In Renaissance Italy, soldier and artist Andrea Orsini serves the ruthless Cesare Borgia, who values Andreaâ€™s wit and deceit as much as another manâ€™s sword. episodes.title: Ivy (1951-01-11)
episodes.episodeDescription: Ambitious Ivy Lexton wants a richer life than her husband Jim can provide and secretly carries on with doctor Roger Gretorex while setting her sights on millionaire Miles Rushworth. She steals poison from Roger's dispensary and murders Jim, allowing suspicion to fall on Roger, who confesses rather than expose the woman he loves. As Roger's execution approaches, a witness finally admits seeing Ivy take the poison and the police uncover both motive and evidence. Roger is reprieved, Miles rejects Ivy after learning what the police know, and the fortune-teller's prophecy that has haunted Ivy closes in on her. With nowhere left to run, Ivy calls Detective Lieutenant Martin and says she will be waiting for him.

episodes.title: The Big Lift (1951-01-18)
episodes.episodeDescription: American airmen Hank and Danny are sent into the Berlin Airlift, flying food and supplies into a city cut off by the Soviet blockade. Hank is openly suspicious of Germans after the war, while Danny becomes romantically involved with Frederica, a young German woman whose ruined city and uncertain future awaken his sympathy. Their experiences gradually force both men to look beyond wartime labels and confront what occupation, defeat, and democracy mean in everyday life. Danny proposes to Frederica, only to discover a letter revealing that she has been using him as a path to the United States while planning to reunite with another man there. Hurt, he breaks off the marriage. Hank, meanwhile, learns from Gerta that democracy includes the freedom to challenge authority, and both airmen leave Berlin with a more complicated understanding of the people they had first judged so simply.

episodes.title: Spellbound (1951-01-25)
episodes.episodeDescription: Psychoanalyst Constance Peterson falls in love with the newly arrived Dr. Edwards, then discovers that the man is an amnesiac impostor who cannot remember his own identity and fears he may have murdered the real Edwards. Constance follows him when he flees and, with her old mentor Dr. Brulov, uses his dreams and phobias to recover the buried memories behind his guilt. He finally remembers that he is John Ballantine, an Army veteran whose childhood trauma came from accidentally causing his brotherâ€™s fatal fall, and that Dr. Edwards died during a skiing trip at Gabriel Valley. A bullet in Edwardsâ€™s body seems to condemn John after all, but Constance interprets the final symbols in his dream and realizes that retiring hospital chief Dr. Murchison had followed Edwards to the resort and shot him. She confronts Murchison, talks her way past his gun, and calls the police, clearing John and freeing the couple to marry.

episodes.title: Take a Letter Darling (1951-02-01)
episodes.episodeDescription: Advertising executive A.M. MacGregor hires artist Tom Verney as her male secretary, expecting him to provide the social charm that helps her handle conservative male clients. Tom resents being treated as a decorative employee, but the two become increasingly dependent on one another while wealthy Southern client Jonathan Caldwell complicates matters by courting Mac. Tom's outrageous parting gift finally blows up Mac's expected match with Caldwell, and when she realizes Tom is leaving for Mexico she abandons the business-first pose and admits she is in love with him.

episodes.title: Lucky Jordan (1951-02-08)
episodes.episodeDescription: Self-centered racketeer Lucky Jordan is drafted into the Army and immediately looks for a way around service, only to become entangled with a stolen briefcase containing sensitive military plans. At first Lucky treats the papers like any other commodity and considers selling them for a fortune, while Jill tries to make him understand that the war and the country's survival affect even a man who believes only in himself. Rival gangsters and enemy agents pursue the plans, forcing Lucky to use the same street instincts that built his criminal career to recover and protect them. By the end, his cynicism has given way to a reluctant sense of responsibility, and he chooses his country over the payoff he once wanted.

episodes.title: Dark Victory (1951-02-15)
episodes.episodeDescription: Wealthy, reckless Judith Traherne learns that a brain tumor has left her only a short time to live, even though surgeon Frederick Steele initially tries to shield her from the full prognosis. Anger and fear drive Judith back toward drinking and self-destruction, but her love for Fred finally gives her a reason to face death rather than flee from it. They marry and build a quiet life together, knowing that sudden blindness will signal the end. When that moment comes, Judith insists Fred leave on an important medical trip so he will remember her courage instead of watching her die. She says goodbye, arranges for a friend to care for him, lies down alone with his pillow beside her, and meets death without fear, calling that courage their victory over the dark.

episodes.title: No Minor Vices (1951-02-22)
episodes.episodeDescription: Pediatrician Perry Ashwell casually dismisses artist Octavio Quaglini's work as junk, inspiring the flamboyant painter to teach the smug doctor a lesson in emotion. Octavio insinuates himself into Perry's home and marriage, deliberately stirring jealousy by charming Perry's wife April and making Perry believe his secure domestic life may not be so secure after all. The comic scheme ultimately makes Perry and April recognize how much they need one another, while Octavio leaves satisfied that he has finally learned how to suffer and has shaken the doctor out of complacency.

episodes.title: A Foreign Affair (1951-03-01)
episodes.episodeDescription: Iowa congresswoman Phoebe Frost arrives in occupied Berlin to investigate the morals of American troops and quickly discovers evidence that nightclub singer Erika von SchlÃ¼tow, a former Nazi favorite, is being protected by an American officer. That officer is Captain John Pringle, who has been supplying Erika with food and favors while keeping her off labor details. To divert Phoebeâ€™s investigation, John romances the prim congresswoman, only to find himself genuinely falling for her. Military intelligence then orders him to continue seeing Erika as bait for her fugitive Nazi lover, Hans Otto Birgel. Erika exposes Johnâ€™s double life to Phoebe just as the trap closes. Birgel emerges at the nightclub and tries to kill John and Erika, but military police shoot him first. Once Phoebe learns that John was acting under orders, the pair reconcile, while Erika is finally taken away to a labor detail.

episodes.title: Bachelor Mother (1951-03-08)
episodes.episodeDescription: Department-store clerk Polly Parish finds an abandoned baby and is mistaken for its mother, a misunderstanding that follows her back to work when the foundling home and her employers decide she must accept responsibility for the child. Store heir David Merlin becomes personally involved in Polly's predicament and gradually falls in love with her, while his father becomes convinced the baby is David's own secret son. By the time Polly can explain that she is not the mother at all, David no longer cares: he publicly claims the child as his, declares that he and Polly are marrying that night, and only then learns she still has one final surprise about the baby's true parentage.

episodes.title: Thelma Jordan (1951-03-15)
episodes.episodeDescription: Assistant district attorney Cleve Marshall, unhappy at home and drinking after hours, meets the mysterious Thelma Jordan when she comes to the district attorneyâ€™s office about supposed break-ins at the home of her wealthy aunt Vera. Cleve begins an affair with her, unaware that Thelma and her lover Tony Laredo have been planning to rob Vera. When Vera catches Thelma at the safe, Thelma shoots her and then calls Cleve, who becomes trapped into destroying evidence and helping construct her alibi. Cleve later prosecutes the very case he has compromised, and Thelma is acquitted. After the trial Tony returns to claim Thelma and her inheritance, while Cleve finally forces the truth into the open. Thelma admits killing Vera and admits Cleve was meant to be the useful man inside the law, but she also reveals that her feelings for him became real. She leaves with Tony, deliberately drives their car into a crash, and gives a final confession that protects Cleve from being exposed as her Mr. X. Cleve loses his law career, but survives with the possibility of repairing his life with his wife Pamela.

episodes.title: The Great Lover (1951-03-22)
episodes.episodeDescription: Freddie Hunter, an insecure scoutmaster sailing for Europe with his boys, tries to remake himself into a sophisticated ladies' man after meeting a beautiful Duchess and her gambling father. His attempts at high-stakes poker and romance put him in the path of a mysterious card-table murderer, and Freddie soon becomes the chief suspect and has to hide while the ship searches for him. The real killer is Dabney, who plans to murder Freddie and the Duchess and make their deaths look like another disappearance. Freddie and his unlikely canine ally expose and subdue Dabney, clearing Freddie's name and leaving him free to pursue the Duchess as the ship reaches shore.

episodes.title: Next Time We Love (1951-03-29)
episodes.episodeDescription: Young journalist Chris Tyler and actress Sicily marry for love, but their careers repeatedly pull them apart. Chris's foreign assignments and professional setbacks leave Sicily supporting their child through a rising stage career, while loyal friend Tommy remains in love with her and offers the steadier life Chris cannot provide. Years of separation finally bring Chris and Sicily to talk of divorce, with Chris claiming he no longer loves her and urging her toward Tommy. Sicily refuses to believe him and discovers the truth when Chris collapses: he has been hiding a serious illness in a sanitarium because he did not want to burden her. Their love survives the years of missed chances, and Sicily retires at the height of her career to remain with Chris for whatever time they have left together.

episodes.title: The Damned Dont Cry (1951-04-05)
episodes.episodeDescription: Ethel Whitehead escapes a life of poverty by remaking herself as the sophisticated Lorna Hansen Forbes, but every step upward draws her deeper into George Castleman's criminal organization. Ambition, luxury and divided loyalties cost her the people who once mattered to her, while her relationship with Castleman's rival Nick Prenta turns the underworld power struggle personal. After Nick is killed, Ethel finally turns against the racket and gives the full story to a newspaperman so other desperate women will understand the price of taking her path. Castleman comes for her in the final confrontation; Ethel is wounded, but his attempt to silence her is stopped and she is left to face what her ambition has cost.

episodes.title: Hired Wife (1951-04-12)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cement-company owner Stephen Dexter faces a legal maneuver that could freeze his business and property. His lawyer suggests a technical escape: marry immediately, transfer everything to his wife, and divorce later. Stephen intends to marry glamorous Phyllis Walden, but his indispensable secretary Kendall Browning, who has long hidden her love for him behind strict efficiency, ends up becoming the temporary wife instead. Once Kendall controls the property, she proves far better at protecting the company than Stephen expected and refuses to surrender her new position on command. Their supposedly businesslike marriage becomes a comic battle involving Phyllis, a suspicious creditor, a chaperone, and Stephenâ€™s growing jealousy. After the company is saved, Stephen finally realizes that the woman he cannot run his business without is also the woman he loves, only to be reminded that he and Kendall are already married.

After the company is saved, Stephen finally realizes that the woman he cannot run his business without is also the woman he loves, only to be reminded that he and Kendall are already married.

episodes.episodeDescription: Brilliant but hard-edged society woman Helen Wright becomes fascinated by gifted young violinist Paul Boray and uses her money and connections to help his career, even as their attraction grows into an affair. Paul rises to concert fame while Helenâ€™s marriage collapses, and her husband eventually agrees to a divorce. Yet Helen comes to understand that Paulâ€™s deepest commitment is not to any woman but to his music, and that her own drinking, restlessness, and need to escape would eventually damage the life he has built. After speaking with Paulâ€™s longtime friend Gina and his mother, Helen refuses Paulâ€™s plan to abandon his career and run away with her. She ends their relationship instead, telling him that music is in his bones and that he cannot escape the genius that has taken possession of his life.

episodes.title: Jackpot (1951-04-26)
episodes.episodeDescription: Bill and Amy Lawrence seem to strike it rich when Bill wins a radio jackpot made up of thousands of dollars in merchandise, only to discover that the prizes create a huge income-tax bill and almost no cash to pay it. Bill desperately tries to sell everything from soup to watches, loses his job in the process, and nearly wrecks his marriage when Amy mistakes artist Hilda Jones's secret portrait of her for evidence of an affair. A recovered $5,000 payment for a lost prize gives the family enough to meet the tax crisis, Bill lands an even better job, and the couple finally escapes for a vacation. When another giveaway program calls, they refuse to answer and want nothing more to do with jackpots.

episodes.episodeDescription: Young Spanish nobleman Pedro de Vargas defies the Inquisition after its cruel chief, Diego de Silva, falsely accuses his family of heresy and tortures Pedroâ€™s young sister to death. episodes.title: No Time for Love (1951-05-10)
episodes.episodeDescription: Sophisticated magazine photographer Katherine Grant is assigned to photograph the sandhogs building a tunnel under the river and immediately clashes with rough, self-confident worker Jim Ryan. After Ryan is injured protecting her during a construction accident, Kate hires him as a model and sets out to prove that his swagger, manners and physical appeal are completely incompatible with her cultured life and her relationship with wealthy Henry Fulton. Every attempt to make Ryan look ridiculous only makes Kate more attracted to him, while Ryan refuses to be reshaped into the kind of man she thinks she should want. When Kate finally stops treating her feelings as an experiment, she chooses Ryan openly, leaving Henry and her carefully designed ideas about romance behind.

episodes.title: Rogues Regiment (1951-05-17)
episodes.episodeDescription: American intelligence agent Whit Corbett enters the French Foreign Legion in Indochina to identify Nazi war criminal Martin Bruner, whose face and identity have disappeared among thousands of former soldiers. Working with French agent Lili and Colonel Mauclaire, Corbett follows a trail of gunrunning, forged papers and hidden money. Dying Legionnaire Heinrich finally reveals that the man called Riker is Bruner. Corbett tracks him to Saigon, where Bruner tries to escape with a forged passport, a fortune hidden in platinum tools and Lili as a hostage. Corbett overpowers him and brings him back alive; the story closes with Bruner executed for his war crimes.

episodes.title: Back Street (1951-05-24)
episodes.episodeDescription: Ray and Walter fall deeply in love, but a missed meeting and circumstance leave Walter married to Corinne while Ray becomes the hidden woman in his life. For twenty-five years she accepts a back-street existence so Walter can keep his family, children and rising banking career, even refusing to demand the divorce that would make their relationship public. When Walter dies after years of divided loyalties, Ray is left alone with the memory of the life they might have shared and dies soon afterward with his final words still in her heart.

episodes.title: Beyond Glory (1951-05-31)
episodes.episodeDescription: Combat veteran Rocky Gilman enters West Point after World War II and becomes a symbol of the Academy's honor system during a congressional investigation, only to have opposing counsel expose an old accusation that Rocky disobeyed orders in Tunisia and caused Captain Daniels' death. Rocky himself believes the charge because combat trauma has distorted his memory, and he refuses to defend his reputation. A psychiatrist and fellow veteran finally reconstruct the battle and prove that Rocky was knocked unconscious by a tank blast during the critical minutes and could not have committed the alleged disobedience. Vindicated, Rocky graduates from West Point with his faith in himself and the Academy restored.

episodes.title: The Gunfighter (1951-06-07)
episodes.episodeDescription: Notorious gunman Jimmy Ringo comes to town hoping for one quiet meeting with estranged wife Peggy and the young son who barely knows him. His reputation makes peace almost impossible: crowds gather, three brothers hunt him for revenge, and young would-be gunfighters dream of becoming famous by killing him. Marshal Mark Strett buys Jimmy enough time to see Peggy and arrange a possible future reunion, but as Ringo leaves, swaggering Hunt Bromley shoots him from ambush. Dying, Ringo falsely says he drew first so Bromley will escape the law, then condemns him to the same life he hated: forever watching for the next young gun who wants fame by killing the man who killed Jimmy Ringo.

episodes.title: The Ghost Breakers (1951-06-14)
episodes.episodeDescription: Radio crime-buster Larry Lawrence is hired by Mary Carter, who has inherited Black Island off Cuba and the ominous Castillo Maldito. The castle is reputed to be haunted, but Larry follows Mary to the island despite gangsters, warnings, and a very convincing zombie. Inside the castle the pair discover that the supernatural effects are being manufactured to frighten Mary away from a valuable mine on the property. Montgomery and his confederates are behind the ghostly tricks, while Frenchy Duvall closes in from another direction. The rival villains finally shoot each other, the police take control, and Mary keeps the mine. Larry leaves Cuba rich enough to joke about financing her television career, still insisting there are no such things as ghosts even after everything they have seen.

episodes.title: DOA (1951-06-21)
episodes.episodeDescription: Accountant and notary Frank Bigelow walks into a police station to report a murder, his own. While on a trip to San Francisco, someone slipped a lethal luminous poison into his drink, leaving him only days to live. Frank spends those final hours tracing the reason for his murder to a notarized bill of sale involving stolen iridium, a dead man named George Reynolds, and businessman Eugene Phillips. Each clue leads deeper into blackmail, murder, and an effort to silence anyone connected with the document. Frank finally identifies Halliday as the man who poisoned him at the Fisherman club and kills his own murderer in a final confrontation. After completing his statement to the police, Frank collapses and dies; the official report is marked with the grim abbreviation D.O.A., dead on arrival.

episodes.title: The Lady Takes a Chance (1951-06-28)
episodes.episodeDescription: New York bank teller Molly J. Truesdale spends her savings on a fourteen-day guided tour of the West, expecting scenery and a brief escape from her orderly life. At a rodeo she literally catches cowboy Duke Hudkins when a bronco throws him, and the chance meeting turns into a romance. Molly abandons part of her scheduled tour to travel with Duke and his friend Waco, discovering that life with a cowboy means rough roads, horses, camp food, and a man who is far more comfortable making decisions than discussing feelings. Their attraction repeatedly collides with Mollyâ€™s independence and Dukeâ€™s stubbornness, and she finally returns to New York convinced the adventure is over. Duke follows her there, sweeps her back onto the same western bus route, and announces that they will marry when the bus reaches Phoenix. Molly protests every step of the way, but this time she willingly takes the chance on him.

episodes.title: Only Yesterday (1951-07-05)
episodes.episodeDescription: In World War I, young Mary Lane secretly marries soldier Jim Emerson just before his regiment is sent overseas. Mary soon learns she is pregnant and moves to New York, where she gives birth to their son while waiting for Jim to come home. But a wartime concussion leaves Jim with shell shock and large gaps in his memory, including his marriage to Mary, and she raises their son without him while sending unsigned New Year greetings year after year. On the eve of the 1929 crash they meet again as strangers and are instinctively drawn to each other, though Jim still cannot place her. Years later, as Mary is dying, a final letter reaches Jim and restores the missing truth. He comes to her bedside, recognizes the love he lost, and meets their son at last, beginning the father-son relationship Mary had waited years to make possible.

episodes.title: The Fugitive (1951-07-12)
episodes.episodeDescription: In a Latin American country where religion has been outlawed, a hunted priest moves secretly among the poor, trying to continue his ministry while the authorities close in. Fearful and imperfect, he nevertheless risks capture to hear confessions, celebrate Mass, and bring comfort to people who still depend on him. A police lieutenant determined to eradicate the old faith takes hostages and pursues him relentlessly, while Maria Dolores and others help the priest hide. The priest is finally captured after answering what he believes is a dying manâ€™s call and is sentenced to death. Before the firing squad he asks Maria to tell his village to keep faith, insisting that killing him will kill only a man and that someone else will carry the faith forward. Even the lieutenant is shaken by the execution and retreats to drink, unable to erase what the priest represented.

episodes.title: Remember the Night (1951-07-19)
episodes.episodeDescription: Assistant district attorney John Sargent prosecutes shoplifter Lee Leander just before Christmas, then delays the case when he realizes a holiday jury may acquit her out of sympathy. Feeling guilty about leaving her jailed over Christmas, he arranges bail and, learning she grew up near his own Indiana home, takes her along for the holiday. John's warm family gives Lee the first real sense of belonging she has known, and she and John fall in love. He even offers her the chance to remain across the Canadian border, but Lee refuses to damage the career he worked so hard to build. Back in court John subtly tries to lose the case, so Lee stops him by pleading guilty. Before sentencing he asks her to marry him; she chooses to serve her time first, certain that if he still wants her afterward they can begin honestly and as equals.

episodes.title: Stairway to Heaven (1951-07-26)
episodes.episodeDescription: RAF pilot Peter Carter should die when he jumps from a burning aircraft without a parachute, but a celestial mistake lets him survive long enough to meet and fall in love with American radio operator June. When heaven's messenger returns to correct the error, Peter appeals for the right to keep the life he was accidentally given. On earth, neurologist Frank Reeves diagnoses a brain condition and prepares Peter for surgery; in Peter's other reality, Reeves serves as his advocate before a heavenly court. June proves the depth of their love by offering her own life for Peter, and the court grants the appeal. Peter survives the operation with a new date of death far in the future and the chance to live the life he and June nearly lost.

episodes.title: Caged (1951-08-02)
episodes.episodeDescription: Young widow Marie Allen enters womenâ€™s prison for taking part in a forty-dollar robbery committed with her late husband and discovers she is pregnant soon after arrival. Frightened and determined to serve her time cleanly, she is caught between humane superintendent Ruth Benton and brutal matron Evelyn Harper, whose corruption and cruelty help turn prison into a school for crime. Marie gives birth behind bars, but when neither her mother nor the institution can legally keep the baby for her until parole, the child is placed for adoption. A friend dies after being denied release, Harperâ€™s abuse hardens Marie further, and professional criminals begin offering her an easier path outside. By the time parole finally comes, Marie rejects an honest job arranged for her and chooses a criminal connection instead, trading her wedding ring and innocence for the promise of real diamonds and fast money. Benton orders her file kept active, certain the system that helped harden Marie will soon bring her back.

episodes.title: Wuthering Heights (1951-08-09)
episodes.episodeDescription: Cathy and the orphan Heathcliff grow up together at Wuthering Heights with a fierce love that neither can escape, but Cathy's desire for position leads her to marry the gentler, wealthier Edgar Linton. Heathcliff returns after years away with money and bitterness, using Edgar's sister Isabella and ownership of Wuthering Heights as instruments of revenge while Cathy is torn between the life she chose and the man she still loves. Their reunion comes too late: Cathy dies after Heathcliff reaches her, and he begs her spirit to haunt him rather than leave him alone. Years later, witnesses see Cathy and Heathcliff together on the moors, suggesting the lovers finally found each other beyond death.

episodes.title: The Ghost and Mrs Muir (1951-08-16)
episodes.episodeDescription: Widowed Lucy Muir moves with her daughter into Gull Cottage despite warnings that the seaside house is haunted by its late owner, the irascible Captain Daniel Gregg. Lucy refuses to be frightened away, and when money troubles threaten her home, Daniel dictates his colorful sea memoir, Blood and Swash, while she puts it on paper. Their unusual partnership deepens into love, but Daniel urges Lucy to live among the living. She falls for writer Miles Fairley, only to discover that he is already married. Daniel, believing he is standing in the way of her earthly life, has already made her think their years together were only a dream. Lucy grows old at Gull Cottage with only fragments of those memories, and when she finally dies Daniel returns, restores her youthful spirit, and takes her with him into the afterlife.

episodes.title: The Velvet Touch (1951-08-23)
episodes.episodeDescription: Broadway star Valerie Stanton kills her controlling producer Gordon Dunning during a struggle after he threatens to destroy her chance to leave him and marry Michael Morrell. Valerie hides her role while Gordon's former lover Marian Webster falls under suspicion, then Marian's despair ends in suicide and deepens Valerie's guilt. During rehearsals for a new play built around a staged suicide, Valerie can no longer sustain the performance of innocence and finally gives herself up to Captain Danbury.

episodes.title: Mother Is a Freshman (1951-08-30)
episodes.episodeDescription: Widowed Abigail Fortitude Abbott is nearly broke but must keep her daughter Susan at Pointer College, so she exploits an old family scholarship by enrolling there as a freshman herself. Abby soon falls for English professor Richard Michaels, only to discover that Susan has a serious crush on the same man and sees her own mother as a rival. Abby prepares to give Richard up for her daughter, but Susan finally accepts that Richard loves Abby and steps aside, allowing Abby and Richard to plan their marriage.

episodes.title: Broken Arrow (1951-09-07)
episodes.episodeDescription: Prospector Tom Jeffords comes to believe peace is possible between white settlers and the Chiricahua Apache and earns the trust of Cochise. Jeffords helps bring General Howard to negotiate a three-month armistice and later a treaty based on Apache equality and security on their own land. During the peace effort Jeffords marries Apache woman Sonseeahray, but renegade whites led by Slade ambush them and kill her. Grief-stricken Jeffords wants revenge, yet Cochise refuses to let either bad whites or bad Indians destroy the agreement. The armistice holds, and Sonseeahray's death becomes part of the sacrifice that seals a lasting peace.

episodes.title: Raffles (1951-09-14)
episodes.episodeDescription: Gentleman thief A.J. Raffles wants to abandon crime for Gwen, but old friend Bunny's desperate financial trouble pulls him into one final burglary. At Lord Melrose's house Raffles plans to steal a valuable emerald necklace, only to find another burglar already in Lady Melrose's room. Raffles overpowers the intruder and takes the jewels himself, then repeatedly outmaneuvers Inspector Mackenzie while Gwen realizes the truth about the man she loves. When Scotland Yard finally identifies Raffles as the amateur cracksman, he admits it, returns the emeralds and directs Lord Melrose's promised reward to Bunny. Raffles escapes before arrest, but risks one last visit to Gwen to tell her he loves her before disappearing through the window.

Because the Harkness family had never met Patrice, Helen is mistaken for the dead woman and accepts the identity so her child can have a secure home. She falls in love with Bill Harkness, but former lover Stephen Morley discovers the fraud and blackmails her. When Morley is later found murdered, Helen and Bill each try to take responsibility, while Bill's dying mother leaves a confession meant to protect them. Police prove Morley was already dead when Helen fired at him and reveal that his actual killer has been caught, finally freeing Helen to keep the life and family she had feared losing.

episodes.title: Waterloo Bridge (1951-09-28)
episodes.episodeDescription: During the First World War, dancer Myra and officer Roy Cronin meet during an air raid on Waterloo Bridge and quickly fall in love. After Myra is told Roy has been killed, poverty and despair drive her into a life she is ashamed to reveal when Roy unexpectedly returns alive. He still wants to marry her, but after confessing the truth to his understanding mother, Myra decides she cannot let Roy carry her past and leaves him for the last time; years later Roy remembers her on Waterloo Bridge with the good-luck charm she returned to him.
